in_sanskrit.name: Manivel
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manivel एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mani (jewel) + Vel (weapon) - The god of wealth, Manivel, is a form of Lord Murugan. He is believed to bring prosperity and abundance to those who worship him.
